stem: Where was the National Panchayati Raj Day 2025 organised?

options.label: d
options.text: More than one of the above

expl: The 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992, which gave constitutional status to the Panchayati Raj system, came into effect from 24 April 1993. As the 32nd anniversary of this, on 24 April 2025, the national-level main event of National Panchayati Raj Day 2025 was organised in Madhubani district of Bihar (Lohna Uttar Gram Panchayat).

stem: Which day is observed as Holocaust Memorial Day?

options.label: d
options.text: More than one of the above

expl: By United Nations General Assembly Resolution 60/7 (2005), 27 January was declared as the International Day of Commemoration in memory of the victims of the Holo-caust.

World Ozone Day, or the International Day for the Preservation of the Ozone Layer, is observed every year on 16 September. Notably, the Montreal Protocol for the protection of the ozone layer came into effect from 16 September 1987. It is noteworthy that in 1994, the United Nations General Assembly announced the observance of this day.

stem: International Day of Persons with Disabilities is observed on—
expl: International Day of Persons with Disabilities is observed on 3 December. The United Nations General Assembly declared the year 1981 as the International Year of Disabled Persons. On 18 December 2007, the United Nations General Assembly changed the name of International Disability Day to “International Day of Persons with Disabilities”.

expl: National Statistics Day is observed in the country on 29 June. In 2025, the main theme of this day is— “75 Years of the National Sample Survey”.

stem: Which day is known as ‘Diabetes Day’?
expl: World Diabetes Day is observed every year on 14 November.

expl: The theme of International Women’s Day 2018 was— “Time is Now: Rural and Urban Activists Transforming Women’s Lives”. However, the theme of International Women’s Day 2025 is— “For All Women and Girls: Rights. Equality. Empowerment”.

stem: What is the theme of the 2018 International Day of Forests?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: The International Day of Forests was observed worldwide on 21 March 2018. The main theme of this day was “Forests and Sustainable Cities”. The theme of the International Day of Forests, 2025 is “Forests and Food”.

Every year, 11 November is observed in India as ‘National Education Day’. This day is important because it is the birth anniversary of Maulana Abul Kalam Azad, the first Education Minister of independent India.

stem: 'Good Governance Day', which commemorates the birth anniversary of India's former Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee, is celebrated every year on-

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above / More than one of the above

expl: ‘Good Governance Day’ is observed every year on 25 December. It is observed on the occasion of the birth anniversary of former Prime Minister and Bharat Ratna awardee Atal Bihari Vajpayee. The following principles are included under good governance—participation, rule of law, consensus-oriented, effectiveness and efficiency, accountability, transparency, responsiveness, etc.

stem: In which year was the 'International Year of Millets' declared by the United Nations?

options.label: d
options.text: More than one of the above

expl: The United Nations has declared the year 2023 as the ‘International Year of Millets’. Millets are also called Shri Anna. Millets are also known as coarse grains. The United Nations declared the year 2024 as the ‘International Year of Camelids’. The United Nations has declared the year 2025 as the ‘International Year of Cooperatives’, the ‘International Year of Glacier’ Preservation’, the ‘International Year of Peace and Trust’, and the ‘International Year of Quantum Science and Technology’.

stem: Which international year has the United Nations General Assembly declared for the year 2019?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: The United Nations General Assembly declared the year 2019 as the following International Years— (i) International Year of Indigenous Languages. (ii) International Year of Moderation. (iii) International Year of the Periodic Table of Chemical Elements. The year 2016 was observed as the ‘International Year of Pulses’. (iv) 2024 – International Year of Camelids. The United Nations General Assembly announced that the year 2025 will be observed as— (i) International Year of Cooperatives. (ii) International Year of Peace and Trust. (iii) International Year of Quantum Science and Technology. (iv) International Year of Glacier’ Preservation.

stem: What was the theme of the International Olympic Day, 2024, which is celebrated every year on June 23?

options.label: c
options.text: "Move forward, learn, discover - together for a better world"

expl: The theme of International Olympic Day, 2024 was “Let’s Move and Celebrate”. The theme of International Olympic Day, 2025 is “Let’s Move?”. It is known that International Olympic Day is observed on 23 June every year. It is noteworthy that the first International Olympic Day was observed on 23 June 1948.
